title: Traveler? Explorer? Record it anywhere with you
content: Best travel app I have ever
author: QAZQAZQQQ

title: Pretty good.
content:
Straight forward idea for a game. I always enjoy taking new routes to uncover more of the world. I like that it just runs in the background and you don’t have to think about it. 

When coverage is patchy you need to have your device against the window for it to work. 

Customer service never got back to me when I needed help so that was a bit disheartening.
author: Jermachi

title: 無預警資料遺失
content:
在9月30日一次使用時，系統突然卡住不能使用10分鐘左右；不得已重新打開，等級完全歸零。雖然有備份，但並非最新版本；又恰巧正在旅行，近期資料完全遺失，損失相當大。
但最讓人心寒的是向官方FB反應卻完全沒有回應。
author: Jilhan Wang

title: Must be one of my favorite app
content: 對於喜歡紀錄生命的人來說是個非常好玩的App，出國或是又去新地方旅遊，看到自己走過的路線覺得超有成就感！已經玩了三年才想到要來給評價，真的非常喜歡，要是沒有這麼耗電就更好了，但還是值得推薦。
author: Chirpspeep

title: does not clear the fog at where I am or has been
content:
All covered by fog. GIS accurately locate my location on map, however, entire map is still covered with fog. Have full strength 4G signals. 

Money well wasted on the app
author: blachel

title: All about the journey!
content: This is a great tool to record where you have been in the world. I even travel a different route to work everyday. Makes you see something new all the time.
author: M-e-e-e-e

title: One question
content: How can I add plane track to the app?  It seems that only recognize the road and ship track.
author: Hiver1123

title: Awesome! Real world exploring became more fun.
content: Excellent app. I do find the location tracking status on even when you stop recording so I need to open and force close there all multiple times for the location tracking to turn off.
author: blueaura18

title: Best app ever
content: Goddamn I love this app. It makes going on adventures into a game and I love that concept. Can't wait to head overseas and track where I go. Also handy for nights out in foreign places being able to retrace my steps to find my lost I.D
author: wookie0900

title: best
content: best app ever
author: Finding useful

title: Best if its kind
content: There are a lot of map apps but I like the way this up reveals where you've been. It's cool seeing what countries you've visited and prompts you to travel more.
author: Subsidise the bread

title: EXCELLENT APP!
content: I looove this app. It's my travel map diary. Highly recommended!
author: Dima827

title: New Favorite App: needs some more development
content: Love this app so much. It has encouraged me to find new places and explore more than I did before! Very clever but it needs some development: I think there should be more "achievements" not the current few. Perhaps regional based ones would be awesome.
author: LawrenceT

title: Fave app ever
content: This is my all time favourite app that I was fortunately introduced to by a tech friend. Absolutely fell in love with it. It's become a bit of an obsession and a fun game for exploring side streets by walk and driving to new places. Such a neat idea!
author: Thythekat

title: Really fun app
content:
This is a very cool app iv been tracking all around recently and it is very interesting to see the exact Path I took. 

The only down side is it uses a lot of battery constantly using the gps. But there is no way around that on iPhones and iPads.

All and all a very cool app and one everyone should be using when traveling or generally moving about. 

5 STAR
author: Sandman 3582

title: Great but sometimes crashes
content: Love this app. However it crashes often on long drives leaving big gaps on my path. (4s) I often restart my phone and close all running apps before I use it but nothing seems to work.
author: Rricechips

title: More features
content: Wish there was a way to manually clear the fog to trace the roads that weren't uncovered because of low GPS signal, as well as to clear the fog on countries you've been to before just to record it. :(
author: Cleigne

title: Woooooooow
content: This is the best idea I have ever seen lolol looove it !
